description: Atlantis survives the first Wraith assault, gains the Daedalus and Ronon Dex, and begins experimenting with ways to fight or even transform the Wraith while new alliances repeatedly prove dangerous.

s02e01.description: The Daedalus arrives as the Wraith siege reaches its climax, giving Atlantis one last chance to save the city without revealing Earth.

s02e02.description: A Wraith computer virus infiltrates the Daedalus during its return journey and begins manipulating the ship toward a catastrophic destination.

s02e03.description: Sheppard's team meets Ronon Dex, a former Wraith Runner who has survived years with a tracking device embedded in his back.

s02e04.description: A transporter accident leaves Cadman's consciousness sharing McKay's body, forcing two incompatible personalities into one increasingly awkward existence.

s02e05.description: The team crashes on a seemingly advanced world whose government secretly feeds convicted prisoners to the Wraith.

s02e06.description: McKay becomes obsessed with repairing an Ancient energy weapon and ignores mounting evidence that the experiment could destroy an entire solar system.

s02e07.description: A man hides his Wraith daughter from his village and asks Beckett's experimental retrovirus to make her fully human before her hunger takes over.

s02e08.description: Sheppard begins undergoing a dangerous transformation after exposure to Ellia's altered Wraith biology, leaving Beckett racing to reverse it.

s02e09.description: The team discovers the Ancient warship Aurora and enters a virtual world where its sleeping crew still believes their war against the Wraith continues.

s02e10.description: Ford captures Sheppard's team and forces them into his plan to attack a Wraith hive using soldiers enhanced by Wraith enzyme.

s02e11.description: The failed hive assault leaves the team scattered and captured while McKay struggles with Wraith enzyme withdrawal and Ford refuses to abandon his war.

s02e12.description: Sheppard becomes trapped inside an Ancient sanctuary where time moves far faster than outside and escape may cost him decades of life.

s02e13.description: Atlantis learns that a saboteur linked to the Trust has planted a bomb intended to destroy the city when the Stargate is activated.

s02e14.description: McKay is trapped in a sinking puddle jumper and imagines Samantha Carter helping him reason through dwindling air and impossible rescue choices.

s02e15.description: A feudal society is ruled by a family with the Ancient gene and access to powerful technology, drawing Sheppard into a succession struggle.

s02e16.description: Alien consciousnesses take control of Sheppard and Weir and resume a personal war that ended long before their bodies were found.

s02e17.description: The disappearance of Genii contacts exposes a coup led by Ladon Radim and forces Atlantis to decide whether his apparent rebellion can be trusted.

s02e18.description: A confused man in Atlantis learns he is actually a Wraith transformed into human form by Beckett's retrovirus, with memories deliberately replaced.

s02e19.description: A civilization threatened by a supervolcano offers Atlantis an Ancient warship, but evacuating the population becomes a race against planetary destruction.

s02e20.description: A Wraith faction proposes an alliance built around Beckett's retrovirus, but cooperation gives the enemy dangerous access to Atlantis and its knowledge.
